newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Small companies drag down Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Small companies drag down Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius SEMDEX share index lost 0.87 points to 366.90 on Friday because of falling share prices in smaller companies, brokers said.
Volume stood at 20.67 million rupees on 728,198 shares from 16.88 million rupees on 744,279 shares on Wednesday. The market trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Brokers blamed slight fall in the index on falling shares of small companies and said leading stocks were sustained by foreign investors.
"Fortunately trading by foreign investors is providing support to the blue chips and this is preventing the SEMDEX from falling at a faster rate," one bourse official said.
On Friday, most leading stocks were unchanged but hotel concern Sun Resorts' price rise limited the Semdex downturn. Sun Resorts gained 40 cents to 42.10 rupees on 42,165 shares.
Foreign investor trading was seen in New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) which was unchanged at 34 rupees on a heavy 375,000 shares. NMH accounted for more than half of the day's total volume.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 86 rupees on 10,000 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11.10 rupees on 61,800 shares.

In the commerce sector, Rogers was one rupee lower to 99 rupees on 5,049 shares, Happy World Foods lost 50 cents to 16 rupees on 2,776 shares and Courts (Mammouth) shed 15 cents to 5.25 rupees on 3,900 shares.
British American Insurance was stable at 8.05 rupees on 29,765 shares but Mauritius Breweries was down 3 rupees to 135 rupees on 770 shares.
Fincorp Investment lost 50 cents to 80 rupees on 2,500 shares and National Investment Trust (NIT) was 40 cents down to 12.40 rupees on 13,050 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert climbed 40 cents to 38.50 rupees on 250 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 44 rupees on 13,250 shares.
